messages:
vivian_sales: Heads-up 4E2 Prospect StratusPay (payments orchestration) submitted a security questionnaire and asked for a 72h POC. Core asks: SAML SSO, SCIM bulk+delta (target 60k), RBAC with delegated admin roles + audit trails, domain ownership locking (they prefer an automated ACME or DNS-based flow), EU data residency, and a Hosted vs Dedicated pricing delta. Procurement wants a 1-page SOW + pricing paragraph by EOD. Can we triage owners?
kevin_se: noted. Do they want us to run Hosted first?
vivian_sales: yes — they want Hosted quick validation but want a costed migration path to Dedicated for SLA and data residency. Procurement wants numbers and a one-line SOW.
miguel_eng: sizing guidance: for 60k SCIM with 120 TPS burst gen recommend 5-GPU reserved pool with 1.5x burst headroom. Committed range roughly $33k-$78k/month depending on model family and quantization. Hosted POC for 72h (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) commonly < $1.5k.
miguel_eng: perf note: prefix KV caching + adaptive batching keeps p95 low; suggest a quantized model variant for the POC to control cost. We'll also include a cache warm-up period.
kevin_se: SCIM: they asked if we support event-driven deltas (webhook/stream) instead of nightly PATCH. We normally support full import + PATCH deltas; we can accept event streams upstream and translate into PATCH operations during POC. We can also offer a temporary SCIM rate bump (2-4x) for the pilot with advisory backoff.
kevin_se: sample SCIM mapping to send:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "externalId": "employee_id",
  "userName": "email",
  "name": {"givenName": "first_name", "familyName": "last_name"},
  "emails": [{"value": "email", "type": "work"}],
  "groups": ["roles"]
}
```
miguel_eng: ACME domain lock option: we can validate domain ownership via DNS TXT or an automated ACME HTTP-01/TLS-ALPN-01 challenge flow if they prefer automation. We'll provide both flows; ACME will let infra teams auto-provision certs and verify ownership without manual DNS edits. TXT verification is still fastest for manual POCs. Verification usually completes within 1-2 hours after records/cert issuance.
isla_sec: security checklist: ask StratusPay to return: completed questionnaire, IdP metadata XML (entityID, ACS URL, x509 cert), explicit SCIM ops required (create/update/patch/delete), expected sync cadence (bulk window), data classification (PII/payment tokens?), retention & audit window, and whether HSM-backed keys are mandatory. We'll provide SOC2 link, DPA template, redacted pen-test summary, and KMS/HSM options doc.
isla_sec: short security blurb for procurement: "SOC2 Type II; DPA template available; redacted pen-test summary attached. EU-region tenancy supported for data residency. Managed KMS by default; enterprise HSM options via PKI integrations. Audit logs retained per plan and can be extended for Dedicated deployments."
vivian_sales: can someone draft the 1-paragraph Hosted vs Dedicated pricing (include commit range) so I can paste into procurement email? Need by EOD.
miguel_eng: pricing paragraph draft: "Hosted: pay-as-you-go usage billing, quick to spin up for short evaluations and light production. Typical 72h POC (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) generally under $1.5k. Dedicated: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput, latency SLAs and private tenancy/data residency; for a 5-GPU cluster sized for 120 TPS bursts expect a committed spend in the ~$33k-$78k/month range depending on model family and quantization. One-time POC engineering and security support can be covered by pilot credits or listed as a professional services line item in the SOW."
kevin_se: POC plan suggestion:
- Day 0: exchange IdP metadata, create SP tenant, provide SCIM test tokens and ACME/DNS verification instructions
- Day 1: run full SCIM import (10k sample -> validate mapping & RBAC), run SSO end-to-end test (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated)
- Day 2: ramp import to 60k (or staged ramp), validate delegated admin flows and audit logs
- Day 3: perf smoke (ramp to 120 TPS bursts), produce latency/cost report, handoff security artifacts and SOW close
We can compress to 48-72h if StratusPay provides IdP metadata + sample CSV and chooses TXT verification. Ask them for 3 test domains and a 100-row CSV to get started.
isla_sec: I'll upload the security pack to shared drive and prepare the DPA. Who owns DPA counterparty contact?
marie_legal: send me their procurement/legal POC and I'll queue DPA review.
infra_bot: ticket #POC-13001 created: StratusPay POC 4CB owners: miguel_eng (infra/perf), kevin_se (integration), isla_sec (security). Link: https://redwood.internal/poc/POC-13001
vivian_sales: great 44D I'll send StratusPay the ask: IdP metadata, legal contact, 100-user CSV, and whether they prefer ACME or DNS TXT for domain lock. Note: procurement wants a one-line SOW 4DD and the pricing paragraph now. I'll paste Miguel's drafts.
kevin_se: I'll prep the SP metadata and a small staging script for bulk import. Also link to a short mapping guide for their IdP team.
vivian_sales: thanks team 44C Please keep updates here and drop any procurement replies into this thread.
